page.overview:
What is Vaniville Town?

Vaniville Town is a small town in Kalos. It is the player character's hometown and is located at the southeast corner of the region. It is also the hometown of the player's two friends: Shauna and Serena (if the player is male) or Calem (if the player is female).

After becoming the Champion, Shauna will appear in front of the player's house, available for a trade with an unevolved form of her starter Pokémon (i.e. the starter Pokémon weak to the player's) that she found in an Egg.

If the player chooses: Chespin= This Froakie has perfect Speed IV.

Fennekin= This Chespin has perfect Attack IV.
